pages.title: Magic Water Sort: Color Puzzle
pages.creator: PubgGame
pages.description:
Magic Water Sort: Color Puzzle asks you to separate mixed water colors into bottles. Select a bottle, then choose another to pour into. A pour is allowed when the receiving bottle is empty or its top color matches the water being poured, and it has enough space.

Finish by leaving each bottle with a single color. The game has hundreds of levels, with extra bottles providing room to work out the sorting order.

pages.title: I Am Monkey
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: I Am Monkey is a pet-care game with cooking, cleaning and dress-up activities. Prepare food such as scrambled eggs, juice or salad, help the monkey with bath time and brushing its teeth, and look after minor injuries. Choose clothing and shoes to change its appearance, using clicks and dragging to work through the different care tasks.

pages.title: Break the block there, Brainrot!
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description:
Break the block there, Brainrot! sends you searching inside blocks for collectible Brainrots. Break the blocks, discover rare Brainrots, and sell your finds for points to improve your axe. Traveling farther brings greater rewards, but a block guard poses a threat.

On a computer, WASD moves, Space jumps, and the right mouse button turns the camera. Use the left mouse button to strike or hook a Brainrot. Phone controls use a movement joystick, camera swipes, and action buttons.

pages.title: Tappy Bird - Avoid the Spikes
pages.creator: PHATCAT Games Ltd
pages.description: Tappy Bird - Avoid the Spikes challenges you to keep a bird away from sharp hazards. Tap the screen to lift the bird and collect coins while avoiding the spikes. As the level continues, more spikes appear and there are more opportunities to pick up coins.

pages.title: Satisdom
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Satisdom is a collection of small interactive tasks built around arranging and completing things. Choose a task, then manipulate its objects by dragging or tapping. Activities include sorting items into categories, matching pairs, and putting pieces together. Use a mouse or touchscreen to work through the different puzzles.

pages.title: Woody Hexa
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Woody Hexa challenges you to fill puzzle boards with colored hexagonal blocks. Drag the pieces into position, matching colors while fitting every block without overlaps. Complete the arrangement to move on to the next board. The game includes 250 levels, with layouts that become more complex as you advance.

pages.title: Cat Evolution 2
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Cat Evolution 2 is a cat-themed clicker about progressing through generations of unusual cats. Keep tapping to advance their evolution and unlock new mutations, building up a collection of increasingly strange feline forms. Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the game.

pages.title: Kings and Queens Mahjong
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Kings and Queens Mahjong turns royal treasures into a timed tile-matching puzzle. Find identical pairs of crowns, jewels, and other tiles, selecting pieces that are free on at least one side. Remove every tile to finish the layout.

Hint, Shuffle, and Undo can help when you get stuck. Earn stars as you complete puzzles and work your way up the Royal Leaderboard.

pages.title: Match Masters
pages.creator: Candivore
pages.description:
Match Masters puts two players on the same match-3 board, with turns shared between opponents. Match at least three tiles of one color to earn points. Blue stars charge your booster, while red circles charge your rival's, so the tiles you choose affect both sides.

Use a charged booster to gain an advantage during the match. Tournaments and global leaderboards provide further competition as you develop your approach to the shared board.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot: Neuro Beasts
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Italian Brainrot: Neuro Beasts is a clicker featuring strange animals generated by neural networks. Tap the character to collect neuro-chips, then use the upgrade menu to increase how quickly you earn them. Work toward collecting all the animals and compare your progress with other players on the leaderboards.

pages.title: Mahjong Pet Quest
pages.creator: LUCKY TRY
pages.description: Mahjong Pet Quest replaces traditional tile designs with animals. Select matching pairs to remove them, using tiles that are free and unblocked by other pieces. Clear the entire board to finish a level and continue to the next layout. The puzzles become more difficult as you advance.

pages.title: Mega Lamba Ramp
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description:
Mega Lamba Ramp combines moving a character with driving cars through stunt challenges. Enter a car and perform tricks, working through every car required to complete the level.

WASD or the arrow keys control the character and vehicle. R flips a car, Shift speeds up the character or activates driving nitro, and Space applies the handbrake. On a phone, move the steering wheel left or right and use the forward and backward buttons to accelerate or brake.

pages.title: Escape Room Mystery Key
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Escape Room Mystery Key puts you inside an abandoned school or hospital in a horror-themed escape adventure. Choose a role, examine the rooms, and search for concealed clues and keys that can help you find an exit. Use mouse clicks or taps to interact while investigating the surroundings.

pages.title: Athena Match
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Athena Match is a match-3 puzzle set in Ancient Greece, with Athena guiding your journey. Make groups of at least three identical artifacts to remove them from the board. Each level sets an objective, such as gathering particular artifacts or removing obstacles, and gives you a limited number of moves.

Plan your matches around the current goal and use boosters when a board becomes difficult. The obstacles draw on Greek mythology as you progress through the levels.

pages.title: Hydraulic Press 2D ASMR
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Hydraulic Press 2D ASMR lets you crush a range of objects under a powerful press. Destroy bottles, corn, watermelons, cars, alarm clocks, and pumpkins, watching how each object breaks under the pressure. Crushing more objects lets you increase the press's crushing power.

pages.title: Paint race
pages.creator: Aizat
pages.description: Paint race challenges you to color a circle while moving around it. Jump over the dark obstacles and collect stars as you paint your way through the levels. Click, tap, press Space, or use W to jump.

pages.title: Puzzle - LINES AND KNOTS 1
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Puzzle - LINES AND KNOTS 1 is a puzzle made from hexagonal pieces marked with lines. Swap the hexagons to assemble each arrangement of nodes. The game contains 150 levels and includes achievements.

pages.title: Hyper Knight
pages.creator: Boombit S.A.
pages.description:
Hyper Knight sends an armored fighter against creatures rising from their graves. Defeat every enemy in a room to open the portal onward, collecting monster souls as you fight. Sell those souls to the Soulkeeper for gold that can strengthen your character.

As you help threatened towns and confront bosses, you can find weapons and armor, discover magical powers, and recruit a companion. An arena becomes available later, offering one-on-one fights against other warriors.

pages.title: Easter Shadow Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Easter Shadow Match asks you to identify the silhouette that matches a picture. Compare the image on the left with the shadows on the right, then choose with the mouse or touchpad. A correct answer earns 200 points; a wrong choice costs 40 points.

pages.title: Smash DIY Slime - Fidget Slimy
pages.creator: AA2G1
pages.description:
Smash DIY Slime - Fidget Slimy lets you make virtual slime, then squash, stretch, and pull it on the screen. Experiment with the slime's textures and laser-printing feature, or collect Popits and press their bubbles.

A separate selection of mini-games includes puzzles and runners. Use the left mouse button to interact with the slime, toys, and other activities.

pages.title: Skibidi Toilet Find the Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Skibidi Toilet Find the Differences gives you one minute to spot seven changes in a pair of Skibidi Toilet pictures. Compare the small details and select each difference with the mouse or by touching the screen. There are ten levels to complete, each with its own set of differences.

pages.title: Fastlane Frenzy
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description:
Fastlane Frenzy turns a kitchen into a miniature racecourse for remote-controlled cars. Drive around tracks set among appliances and utensils, with separate keyboard controls for two players.

Player one drives with the arrow keys and uses P to respawn. Player two uses WASD to drive and R to respawn their car.

pages.title: Skibidi Laboratory
pages.creator: Merson
pages.description:
Skibidi Laboratory sends you through a lab full of obstacles, crystals, and cameramen. Gather every crystal in the level while avoiding danger, then use your newly available shooting ability to destroy all the enemies and reach the end.

On a keyboard, use W, A, and D to move, and K to shoot after collecting all the crystals. On-screen buttons provide the controls on a phone.

pages.title: Dumpling Jumpling
pages.creator: Nord Beaver
pages.description:
Dumpling Jumpling follows a dumpling escaping its cooking pot by jumping higher and higher. Time each jump to avoid moving blocks flying in from the sides, and climb toward new views and a higher score. Lining blocks up in a row earns extra points.

Jump with the left mouse button or Space, or tap the screen.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Challenge 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Challenge 2 asks you to clear bubbles quickly while more keep arriving. Shoot a bubble at matching colors to form a group of at least three and pop it. Clearing a larger group in one shot earns more points. Keep building your score, then submit it to the leaderboard at the end.

pages.title: Color Ball Run 2048
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Color Ball Run 2048 combines a moving obstacle course with number merging. Slide left or right to steer your numbered ball into another ball with the same value, combining them into a higher number. Avoid the obstacles that can end your run as you work toward a ball numbered 2048.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Treasure Rush
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Treasure Rush challenges you to gather the required number of bubbles and treasure. Aim and release bubbles toward matching ones to work toward those targets, while keeping bubbles away from the border. Play with the mouse or touchpad.

pages.title: Stack Colors
pages.creator: VOODOO
pages.description: Stack Colors challenges you to bring as many matching objects as possible to the finish. Collect objects that match your character's color and avoid the others. Picking up a different color removes some of your collection; losing all of it ends the run.

pages.title: Ball Legs 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Ball Legs 3D is a race between your ball and three computer-controlled rivals. Reach the finish first by rolling on slopes to gain speed and using the ball's legs to climb across the course. Press and hold to move faster as you try to overtake the other racers.

pages.title: Archery King
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Archery King challenges you to aim arrows at a target. Take on twenty-four increasingly difficult levels on your own, or challenge a friend to compare your accuracy.

Hold the left mouse button to begin aiming, drag to adjust your shot, and release to fire the arrow.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Winter Pack
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Winter Pack is a winter-themed matching game with forty-eight levels. Aim bubbles at matching ones and clear every bubble before the time runs out. Keep them from reaching the border as you work through the stages. Use the mouse or touchpad to play.

pages.title: Boat Rescue Challenge
pages.creator: BestGameSpot
pages.description: Boat Rescue Challenge asks you to guide a small boat out of a trap. Navigate past obstacles and collect three keys to unlock the door and escape. Move the boat with the left mouse button or by swiping the screen, keeping clear of the traps along the route.

pages.title: DIY Pop Toys Fun 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: DIY Pop Toys Fun 3D lets you make a bubble toy on a virtual machine. Swipe to place colorful cubes on its platform and build the toy's pattern. Once the toy is ready, press all its bubbles.

pages.title: Donut Sort Fun
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Donut Sort Fun is a color-sorting puzzle played with donuts stacked on cylinders. Rearrange the rings so that donuts of one color end up together. The puzzles become harder as you progress. Use the mouse or tap to play.

pages.title: Bag Design Shop
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Bag Design Shop lets you design and decorate your own bag for a wedding party or another special event. Use the mouse to interact with the bag-design tools and create your finished accessory.

pages.title: I'm not a Monster: Wanna Live
pages.creator: Bin Studio
pages.description: In I'm not a Monster: Wanna Live, you play a girl trying to rescue her childhood toy, Huggy Wuggy, from a glass case in an abandoned toy factory. Work out each puzzle's rules and use the GrabPack's blue and red hands to interact with electrical circuits or grab distant objects. Your goal is to open his case and save him.

pages.title: Yummy Chocolate Factory
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Yummy Chocolate Factory is a cooking game in which you complete chocolate-making tasks with the mouse.

pages.title: Christmas Slide Puzzle
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Christmas Slide Puzzle challenges you to restore a Christmas picture by rearranging its tiles. Click or tap a piece beside the empty space to slide it into that gap, moving the pieces until the image is back in order.

pages.title: Ugi Bugi & Kisiy Misiy
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Ugi Bugi & Kisiy Misiy is a two-character platform game in which both partners must reach the door to advance. Jump between platforms using WASD for one character and the arrow keys for the other. On-screen touch buttons provide movement and jumping controls.

pages.title: Temple Ball
pages.creator: Wanted 5 Games B.V.
pages.description: Temple Ball challenges you to climb as high as possible inside an endless temple. Click to make the ball jump, keep moving upward, and try to beat your high score.

pages.title: Matching Vehicles
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Matching Vehicles asks you to connect at least three identical vehicle pictures to remove them and earn points. Move your finger through matching images to build the connection.

Link five or more vehicles to add time to the clock. As you progress, the remaining time runs down faster, making those longer connections increasingly useful for keeping the game going.

pages.title: Slingshot Jetpack
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Slingshot Jetpack sends you over a city to collect gold coins and reach each level's endpoint accurately. Drag to move during the flight and guide your approach to the finish.

pages.title: RedHaired Fairy Fantasy vs Reality
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: RedHaired Fairy Fantasy vs Reality lets you style two versions of a red-haired fairy: a cartoon heroine and her counterpart from a fantasy television series. Choose outfits and hairstyles for each, then compare their finished looks. Make your selections with the left mouse button or touch controls.

pages.title: Fall Days
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Race through courses and collect crowns in Fall Days. Compete for first place across different maps, then buy costumes to change your character's appearance. Move with WASD or ZQSD, or use the mobile touch controls.

pages.title: Little Princess Magical Tale
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Follow a girl through an interactive fairy adventure in Little Princess Magical Tale. Choose actions from the on-screen buttons to move the story forward. Some scenes ask you to trace marked dots around a hammer shape or brush over object pictures, using the mouse or touch controls to complete the activity.

pages.title: Break The Candies
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Break The Candies challenges you to move a candy around obstacles until it touches its target and breaks the candies together. Use the arrow keys to guide it through forty levels, finding a route that avoids the obstacles.

pages.title: Hazel And Mom's Recipes
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Cook alongside Baby Hazel and her mother in Hazel And Mom's Recipes. Follow Mom's instructions as you work through the recipes in the cookbook, using the mouse on a desktop or the touchscreen on a mobile device.

pages.title: Cash Back
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cash Back puts you behind a store counter to calculate customers' change. Return the correct amount with a combination of dollar notes and coins, scoring correct transactions and generating sales for the shop.

pages.title: 3d Billiard Piramid
pages.creator: LisGames
pages.description:
3d Billiard Piramid is a pocket-billiards game played on a table with narrow pockets. Break the pyramid, then choose a ball and use it to strike another. The ball you strike with can only be pocketed after it contacts another ball.

Be the first to pocket eight balls to win. Sending a ball off the table or failing to contact another ball costs a turn. Shot strength also affects aiming accuracy.

pages.title: Penguin Adventure
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Penguin Adventure challenges you to collect every diamond and unfreeze the penguin's girlfriend. Tap the penguin and drag to set the power of your move, keeping clear of spikes, fireballs and other creatures that can hurt him. Work through nine levels whose challenges become harder as you advance.

pages.title: Mr Shooter
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Mr Shooter is a shooting challenge with eighty levels of enemies to take down. Move the mouse to aim and press the left mouse button to fire, lining up precise shots as you work through the stages.

pages.title: Archer Warrior
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Ride into each level as a mounted archer in Archer Warrior. Your horse rushes forward while you steer the rider left and right and shoot enemies with your bow. Each level gives you a task to complete as you advance along the road. Swipe on the screen to control the action.

pages.title: Kids Car Puzzles
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Kids Car Puzzles gives you a choice between dot-to-dot and jigsaw activities. Connect dots in one mode or put puzzle pieces together in the other, using the mouse or touch controls to play.

pages.title: Car Logo Mahjong Connection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Clear the board in Car Logo Mahjong Connection by joining tiles that show the same car logo. Each connecting path may bend at most twice, with each turn forming a right angle. Use the mouse to choose valid pairs and work through the levels.

pages.title: Quad Bike Derby Stunts
pages.creator: gamefun
pages.description: Race a quad bike over dusty desert trails in Quad Bike Derby Stunts. Compete against other drivers for the off-road championship, keeping clear of heavy traffic as you ride. Control the quad with the keyboard.

pages.title: High Speed Fast Car : Drift & Drag Racing game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: High Speed Fast Car : Drift & Drag Racing game combines 3D driving with drifting and drag racing. Take control of the car and perform drifts, using the left mouse button to play.

pages.title: Cute Vehicle Coloring Book
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Cute Vehicle Coloring Book gives you vehicle illustrations to color, including a quadricycle. Use the mouse to add color to the pages and create your own version of each vehicle.

pages.title: Blueberry Muffins
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Blueberry Muffins walks you through a recipe for muffins with blueberries and a cinnamon-sugar crumble topping. Follow the game’s instructions to complete the baking activity and prepare the finished batch.

pages.title: Girl Fashion Closet
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Explore Barbie’s wardrobe in Girl Fashion Closet and put together her outfit. Try on different clothes, then combine them with earrings, necklaces, shoes and bags. Click or tap to experiment with the clothing and accessory combinations and create her look.

pages.title: Cartoon Bus Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rebuild six cartoon bus pictures in Cartoon Bus Puzzle. Choose an image and assemble its jigsaw pieces until the picture is complete. Each image offers 16-, 36-, 64- and 100-piece modes, so you can choose how many pieces you want to arrange. Use the mouse to play.

pages.title: Xtreme Monster Truck Offroad Racing Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Race monster trucks against rival drivers in Xtreme Monster Truck Offroad Racing Game. Take the 4x4 vehicles through countryside courses with hills, valleys and jumps. Muddy tracks add to the off-road driving challenge.

pages.title: Fun Learning For Kids
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Match colorful pictures to their silhouettes in Fun Learning For Kids. Choose the object that fits the outline and drag it into place, working with animals, household objects and things from nature. A correct match completes the puzzle and lets you move on to the next one; an incorrect choice lets you try again. Later puzzles present more pictures to choose from, so compare their outlines carefully.

pages.title: Flying Car Driving Simulator
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Flying Car Driving Simulator lets you drive and fly a Lamborghini while taking on a range of missions. Carry out rescues, pursue thieves and follow celebrities to earn cash. You can also launch the car from skyscrapers.

pages.title: Drifting Cars Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble drifting-car pictures in Drifting Cars Slide by exchanging adjacent tiles. Select one piece and click a neighboring tile to swap their places, then keep rearranging until the image is back in its original order. Choose from three pictures and three grid sizes: 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5.

pages.title: Christmas Town Difference
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Christmas Town Difference gives you pictures with small changes between them. Find and select seven differences in each scene before its one-minute time limit runs out. There are ten levels to complete, using mouse clicks or taps to mark the mismatched details.

pages.title: Bird Quest: Adventure Flappy
pages.creator: PowerSlash Studios
pages.description: Fly past monsters and obstacles in Bird Quest: Adventure Flappy. Use mouse or touch controls to stay airborne and collect coins, stars and diamonds along the way. Gather these pickups to increase your points and work toward buying new birds.

pages.title: NonStop Cars
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Make your car jump with the left mouse button in NonStop Cars. Collect diamonds during your runs and use them to buy different cars, while trying to push your score as high as you can.

pages.title: Snowball Office Fight
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Turn the workplace into a snowball battle in Snowball Office Fight. Hit your colleagues with throws before they strike back, and earn a salary for every successful hit. Face different coworkers and a Santa boss level. There is also a tiny Christmas mouse to try to hit as an extra target.

pages.title: Connect The Christmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Connect The Christmas asks you to join matching Christmas characters in pairs. Click or tap a character, then drag to draw a path to its partner.

pages.title: Slope Racing
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Drive over slopes and gather coins in Slope Racing. Use the arrow keys to control the car as you travel across the uneven ground. Spend the coins you collect on other cars or different environments, including a desert setting.

pages.title: Balls Rotate 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Balls Rotate 3D challenges you to guide a ball through an obstacle course to the finish. Use the left mouse button, pressing and releasing to control your progress through the level. Different skins let you change the ball's appearance.

pages.title: Knight in Love
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Knight in Love sends a knight to rescue a princess captured by a dragon. Control him with the mouse as he strikes the castle, gathering gold and diamonds along the way. Use these resources to improve his weapons and equipment and continue the rescue effort.

pages.title: Sweet Romantic Room Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Reassemble room pictures in Sweet Romantic Room Slide. Use the mouse to slide the picture pieces back into place. The game includes three images and three modes, giving you a choice of scene and puzzle setting.

pages.title: BMW X6 M50i Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: BMW X6 M50i Puzzle turns six pictures of the car into jigsaws. Pick a picture and choose how many pieces to arrange: 16, 36, 64 or 100. Use the mouse to rebuild the image, choosing a smaller puzzle or a larger set of pieces for the same picture.

pages.title: Wild West Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Choose one of twelve pictures in Wild West Jigsaw and rebuild it piece by piece. The three difficulty settings change the size of the puzzle: easy uses 25 pieces, medium has 49, and hard has 100. Click with the mouse or tap the screen to play.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Birthday Surprise
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Birthday Surprise follows Hazel as a phone reminder brings her friend Akito’s birthday to mind. Help Hazel and her friends prepare a surprise party for him. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and take part in the birthday preparations.

pages.title: Rail Road Crossing 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Rail Road Crossing 3D puts you in charge of traffic at a railway crossing. Use the mouse to regulate the movement of cars and trains through the crossing.

pages.title: BMW 8 Series Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Put BMW 8 Series pictures back together in BMW 8 Series Puzzle. There are six images to choose from, and each can be played as a jigsaw with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Select a picture and piece count, then use the mouse to assemble the car image.

pages.title: FPS Shooter 3D City Wars
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: FPS Shooter 3D City Wars is a first-person combat game in which you fight terrorists alongside a team. Move with WASD, aim with the right mouse button and fire with the left. Press R to reload, Space to jump, Ctrl to crouch or X to lie down. Q and E tilt left and right, T activates time dilation, and Esc pauses the action.

pages.title: Hopscotch
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Hopscotch turns the playground game into a path of numbered pillars. Use the mouse to switch the character’s feet between together and apart, matching single platforms and side-by-side pairs. A wrong landing sends the character into the gap and ends the game.

pages.title: Happy Princess Holiday
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Happy Princess Holiday lets you dress a princess for a private fashion party. Choose a look from her fashion collection and put together an outfit for the event.

pages.title: Taxi Driver Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Taxi Driver Simulator puts you behind the wheel of a cab in busy city traffic. Pick up passengers and take them safely to their destinations, using WASD or the arrow keys to drive.

pages.title: Fruit Link
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Fruit Link is a timed matching puzzle in which you connect identical fruits to remove them and build your score. Use the mouse to make connections before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Pop Star Dentist
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Treat the teeth of five performers in Pop Star Dentist. Choose from seven dental tools to repair teeth that are broken, decayed or otherwise damaged. The patients react as you work: they blink, twitch and turn red, adding animated responses to each dental visit.

pages.title: Mine War Heroic Sapper
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Help soldiers cross a minefield in Mine War Heroic Sapper by locating safe areas containing red flags. Apply nonogram logic to search for spots without mines, and click to mark rows or columns you have already solved. Work through 30 levels, aim for 90 stars, and earn medals for different achievements while avoiding mistakes.

pages.title: Ice Queen Tongue Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Queen Tongue Doctor puts you in a doctor's office to help the Ice Queen with her tongue and teeth. Use the game's medical tools to remove bacteria, then examine her teeth with an X-ray to find missing or crooked ones. Finish the dental visit by fitting a pair of braces. Tap to work through the treatment activities.

pages.title: Bitcoin Tap Tap Mine
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Bitcoin Tap Tap Mine is a bitcoin-themed clicker about building an in-game balance. Tap the screen to collect currency, then spend it on hardware upgrades that increase how much you can earn.

The game also offers a prize wheel, a bitcoin faucet, and donations from anonymous donors. Use these additional sources of currency as you work toward more hardware upgrades.

pages.title: EG Crash Car
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Crash Car is an endless driving game built around high-speed runs and ramp jumps. Take one of the available cars onto the course, use the ramps to jump, and try to keep driving without crashing.

pages.title: Zombie Crowd
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Zombie Crowd puts you in charge of a group of zombies in a city. Lead them toward humans and bite people to add followers, building a larger crowd as you roam. Use the map to track humans and zombies, develop your group through zombie upgrades, and use the restore-life option to help keep the crowd alive.

pages.title: Pixel Survival
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pixel Survival combines a pixel-style shooter with gathering supplies and crafting. Choose a character and try to stay alive in the wild, searching for food, water, and tools while using weapons to deal with threats. Look after your supplies as you explore the maps and work with the available crafting items.

pages.title: Go Goat
pages.creator: The Walking Fish
pages.description: Go Goat asks you to make your way down a mountain, guiding your descent from higher ground toward the bottom.

pages.title: Ice Bucket Challenge Celebrity Edition
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Ice Bucket Challenge Celebrity Edition turns the ice-water challenge into a timing game. Tap the buttons at the correct moment to tip icy water over the game's celebrity guests. Work on your timing as the game presents its different guests, including a unicorn alongside the celebrity lineup.

pages.title: Hand Toss
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Hand Toss is a tap-controlled challenge about tossing a man into the air and setting a height record. Tap to begin, then aim for a new best distance as the score is measured in meters.

pages.title: Funny Doggy Hidden Bones
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Funny Doggy Hidden Bones is a hidden-object game about spotting bones in dog pictures. Search each scene and find every hidden bone to complete the challenge. There are five levels and no time limit, so you can examine the pictures at your own pace.

pages.title: Knife Hit 2
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Knife Hit 2 challenges you to throw blades while avoiding other swords, people, and obstacles. Each level gives you a limited supply of cutting weapons, so make your throws count as you progress through the stages. Collect diamonds and spend them in the shop on additional knives.

pages.title: Flags Maniac
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Flags Maniac tests how quickly you can recognize national flags. Work through its flag questions and identify flags from countries around the world, including Switzerland, South Korea, Panama, the Netherlands, Portugal, and India. Try to answer quickly while choosing the correct flag.

pages.title: Creative Puzzle
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Creative Puzzle offers coloring, picture-piece puzzles, and a freestyle coloring mode. Choose an image, fill its sections with colors, or drag the puzzle pieces into their matching areas to complete the picture. Use the picture hint when you need a guide, and try freestyle mode to experiment with your own color choices.

pages.title: Mahjong Deluxe
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description:
Mahjong Deluxe is a tile-matching game with six boards and three difficulty levels. Select pairs of matching tiles to remove them, working to clear the whole layout. A tile must have nothing above it and an open left or right side before you can select it.

Removing a pair can free other tiles for your next move. The game includes hints, a shuffle option, and a restart option if you need to approach a board again.

pages.title: Ice Queen Baby Shower Fun
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description:
Ice Queen Baby Shower Fun is a baby-care game that moves from bath time to dressing up. Keep the baby entertained with toys, wash her hair with shampoo, change her diaper, and use the hair dryer.

Once the care activities are complete, try hats, dresses, and shoes to put together the baby's outfit.

pages.title: Burger Express
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Burger Express is a cooking game about preparing burgers, fries, and other food. Use the mouse to work through the food-preparation activities and make the dishes.

pages.title: Princesses Mall Shopping
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princesses Mall Shopping takes two princesses to the mall for new outfits. Help the first princess shop for clothes, then put together a look for the second. Choose dresses, accessories, and shoes to create their outfits during the shopping trip.
